journey.name: Short Distance Minimum Base Fare
journey.description: Verifies that short trips under 1 kilometer trigger the flat base fare rule of 60 EGP, regardless of duration or traffic conditions.

actions.action: Tap the "Start" button on the home screen. Verify navigation to the distance input screen.
Clear the text field, type "0.6" into "Distance in kilometers", and tap "Next". Verify navigation to the time input screen.
Clear the text field, type "5" into "Time in minutes", and tap "Next". Verify navigation to the traffic options screen.
Tap "Calculate Trip Price" with default "Feeling Lucky (+0%)" selected.
Verify that the estimated price displayed is "60" EGP and the snackbar message "Price Calculated Successfully!" appears.
